policy: This file is a research concordance, not a DSS transcription. Passage ranges are inventory-reported coverage and do not imply that every word in the cited range is extant. No DJD fragment number, IAA imaging-plate number, column/line, or textual reading is asserted unless individually verified. Preliminary inventory data must be checked against published editions and current institutional catalogues before textual comparison.

field_guide.iaa_identifier: IAA catalogue identifier; null until directly correlated.
field_guide.passage_coverage: Scriptural passage ranges reported by the cited inventory; exact surviving wording and completeness require edition-level inspection.
field_guide.condition: Extant status of the precise passage; use unknown when not established.

transcription_source.attribution: Based on a text of the earlier Qumran-Wörterbuch project of the Göttingen Academy of Sciences and Humanities, itself based on a precursor text by Martin Abegg.
transcription_source.use: Online Hebrew transcription with 52 digital display groups representing fragment numbers 1–109; only the first group has been mapped to passage references in this record. The linked comparison texts are not the manuscript transcription.
transcription_source.caution: The displayed line numbers are digital transcription navigation lines, not manuscript column/line coordinates. The transcription juxtaposes the manuscript text with Masoretic and Samaritan Pentateuch readings; those comparison texts must not be mistaken for 4Q27.

records.status: Qumran-Digital transcription and 52-group navigation index linked; published concordance for 27 preserved columns added; fragments 85–109 remain unassigned in the Study Edition
records.caution: The 27 published column assignments are reproduced from The Dead Sea Scrolls Study Edition, p. 252, which cites N. Jastram, DJD XII, 205–267. This column map is not a fragment-group map. The Qumran-Digital page's 52 display groups represent fragment numbers 1–109, but only frg. 1–4 has been individually mapped here; the Study Edition explicitly leaves fragments 85–109 without a passage assignment. Masoretic and Samaritan comparison lines on Qumran-Digital are not 4Q27 readings.
